title: Accounts Receivable Rule: Standing Share on Payable Held Utility Charges
content:
# Standing Share on the Payable Part — Utility Services Program

**Rule.** The payable part of held charges on a Utility Services Program account is reduced by a standing share set by the resident's payment standing. The two tests are: the Apartment Home Lease is enrolled in rent autopay; and at least 6 utility payments were received on the account fewer than six whole months before the payment date.

- **0.80** when both hold;
- **0.90** when exactly one of the two holds;
- the **whole payable part** when neither holds.

The payable part is multiplied by the share; the product is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## All combinations

| Enrolled in rent autopay | Utility payments in the six months | Standing share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 6 or more | 0.80 |
| yes | 5 or fewer | 0.90 |
| no | 6 or more | 0.90 |
| no | 5 or fewer | whole |

*Worked case (hypothetical payable part of $43.02):* both tests met, $34.416, which is $34.42 when rounded at the end; one test met, $38.718, which is $38.72; neither, $43.02.
